mapper.select: /* QueryID=kkdugi.core.security.mapper.SecurityUserDetailsMapper.findAuthoritiesByUsername */ SELECT ab.auth_id, ab.auth_role_cd AS authority, ab.auth_tp_cd, ab.auth_nm FROM kkdugi_user_auth ua JOIN kkdugi_user_base ub ON ub.user_id = ua.user_id JOIN kkdugi_auth_base ab ON ab.auth_id = ua.auth_id WHERE ub.user_login_id = #{username} AND ab.use_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN ua.apl_st_dtm AND ua.apl_ed_dtm
mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE reachable_menu AS ( SELECT mb.menu_id, mb.menu_parent_id, ml.menu_nm, ml.menu_dc, mb.menu_pgm, mb.menu_ico, mb.sort_seq FROM kkdugi_menu_base mb JOIN kkdugi_menu_lang ml ON ml.menu_id = mb.menu_id AND ml.lang_cd = #{langCode} WHERE mb.menu_parent_id IS NULL AND mb.use_yn = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT mb.menu_id, mb.menu_parent_id, ml.menu_nm, ml.menu_dc, mb.menu_pgm, mb.menu_ico, mb.sort_seq FROM kkdugi_menu_base mb JOIN kkdugi_menu_lang ml ON ml.menu_id = mb.menu_id AND ml.lang_cd = #{langCode} JOIN reachable_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = mb.menu_parent_id WHERE mb.use_yn = 'Y' )
mapper.select: /* QueryID=kkdugi.core.security.mapper.SecurityUserDetailsMapper.findMenusByUsername */ , grant_menu AS ( SELECT rm.menu_id, rm.menu_parent_id, rm.menu_nm, rm.menu_dc, rm.menu_pgm, rm.menu_ico, rm.sort_seq, BIT_OR(am.auth_val) AS auth_val FROM kkdugi_user_auth ua JOIN kkdugi_user_base ub ON ub.user_id = ua.user_id JOIN kkdugi_auth_base ab ON ab.auth_id = ua.auth_id JOIN kkdugi_auth_menu am ON am.auth_id = ab.auth_id JOIN reachable_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = am.menu_id WHERE ub.user_login_id = #{username} AND ab.use_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN ua.apl_st_dtm AND ua.apl_ed_dtm GROUP BY rm.menu_id, rm.menu_parent_id, rm.menu_nm, rm.menu_dc, rm.menu_pgm, rm.menu_ico, rm.sort_seq HAVING BIT_OR(am.auth_val) > 0 ), menu_tree AS ( SELECT menu_id, menu_parent_id, menu_nm, menu_dc, menu_pgm, menu_ico, sort_seq, auth_val FROM grant_menu UNION ALL SELECT rm.menu_id, rm.menu_parent_id, rm.menu_nm, rm.menu_dc, rm.menu_pgm, rm.menu_ico, rm.sort_seq, 0 AS auth_val FROM reachable_menu rm JOIN menu_tree mt ON mt.menu_parent_id = rm.menu_id ) SELECT menu_id AS id, menu_parent_id AS parent_id, menu_nm AS title, menu_dc AS remarks, menu_pgm AS program, menu_ico AS icon, sort_seq AS sort, MAX(auth_val) AS authority FROM menu_tree GROUP BY menu_id, menu_parent_id, menu_nm, menu_dc, menu_pgm, menu_ico, sort_seq ORDER BY menu_parent_id, sort_seq NULLS LAST
SELECT user_id, user_login_id, user_pwd, user_stat_cd, pwd_stat_cd, pwd_expr_dtm FROM kkdugi_user_base WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
